name: Sabah
description: Sabah is a Malaysian state located on the northern portion of the island of Borneo. It is known for its diverse wildlife, lush rainforests, and beautiful beaches. Sabah is home to Mount Kinabalu, the highest peak in Southeast Asia, and offers opportunities for eco-tourism, adventure activities, and cultural experiences with indigenous communities.

name: Sarawak Mount Kinabalu
description: Mount Kinabalu is the highest peak in Southeast Asia, located in the Malaysian state of Sabah on the island of Borneo. It is part of the Kinabalu National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and is renowned for its rich biodiversity and unique flora and fauna. The mountain attracts climbers and nature enthusiasts from around the world, offering challenging hikes and breathtaking views from its summit.

name: Penang Hill
description: Penang Hill is a popular tourist destination in Penang, Malaysia. It offers panoramic views of the island and the surrounding areas. The hill is home to a variety of plants and animals, and visitors can enjoy hiking trails and scenic walks.
